name: skeudesign
description: Find, compare and export curated PNG icons from your existing SkeuDesign library in ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Find PNG icons for websites, apps and presentations. Search every category, compare previews, collect a matching set in Icon Tray, and export selected files. Every connected account can use up to 20 fixed icons per category. Existing library entitlements include the full collection. Custom icon generation is not included.
defaultPrompt: Find SkeuDesign icons for a finance dashboard.
Find a matching set of food and drink icons.
